messages:
emma-billing: FYI customer Zipcode Health (acct: ZC-12234) hit an ACH setup failure — bank returned 'account_type_mismatch'. invoice 48921 is due, they asked if we can take a one-time wire to avoid service interruption.
alex-payments: Can you paste the exact bank error? sometimes it's microdeposit vs ACH type mismatch on our side.
emma-billing: Here's the webhook payload we got from payments: `status: failed`, `decline_code: account_type_mismatch`, `bank_message: Account type not supported for microdeposits`. Attached customer message: 'we set up with routing/account for checking'.
nora-finance: Ok. Two quick asks: 1) Does the customer have autopay enabled? 2) Do they have any outstanding disputes/chargebacks? If not, manual wire is fine but we need approval for off-cycle invoice settlement.
ops-oncall: Also confirm they haven't tried instant verification (Plaid/SSN match). If account type is a business checking vs personal, microdeposits sometimes fail.
emma-billing: They do have autopay but it's failing. No disputes listed. Customer rep says they can send wire today if we provide instructions and a billing contact email for remittance.
billing-bot: Payment attempt 2026-12-05 14:02 UTC failed (txn id: pay_8a9c). Retry window opened. Suggest manual retry after customer confirms account.
alex-payments: I'm comfortable with manual wire acceptance. We need: (a) VP Finance sign-off for >$50k? this is $18,740. (b) collect a signed billing agreement addendum (one-off) for audit.
cecilia-vpfinance: @alex-payments approve manual wire acceptance for invoice 48921 ($18,740). Require remittance email + copy of bank reference. No waivers to subscription terms. Proceed.
emma-billing: Thanks @cecilia-vpfinance. Emma to send wiring instructions now.
emma-billing: Wiring details (send to customer):
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: First National Bank
Routing (ABA): 123456789
Account: 987654321
SWIFT: FNBBUS33
Reference: Invoice 48921 - ZC-12234
Remittance to: billing@redwood.ai
```
Please confirm once wire is sent and attach bank reference.
ops-oncall: EMO: remind support to pause retries for autopay for this account until settlement confirmed, otherwise we double-charge.
emma-billing: Noted. I emailed the wire details to the customer and cc'd support+finance. They responded: 'Wire scheduled; will send remittance by EOD PST.'
alex-payments: After wire clears, we'll mark invoice paid and cancel the autopay attempt. Emma, please upload the signed addendum to the billing folder.
emma-billing: Will do. Tagging checklist: attached signed addendum? pending. wire reference? pending. mark payment in ledger when cleared.
billing-bot: System note: flag created for manual settlement (flag id: FLAG-7789). Audit log entry required.
nora-finance: Perfect — once bank posts, I'll reconcile and close. Thanks everyone :tada:
